name: drumtrainer
description: Drum trainer: practise scripted patterns on an electronic kit, timing analysed from MIDI

layout.composition: C=(1:5) A1=(PRE, VOI, KIT, DRP, SWG, ONF, SYNC, ANLZ, ABRS, LAT, COUT, BPM, SVOL, MVOL, IVOL) A2=(ROLL)

performance-page.composition: C=(1:5) A1=(ONF, BPM, ANLZ, SWG, SVOL, MVOL, IVOL) A2=(ROLL)

extra_menus.name: Drum Map

extra_timer_callbacks: if (const auto status = processorRef.pollStatusText()) { m_statusBar.showMessage(*status, status->isNotEmpty()); }
extra_processor_methods: [[nodiscard]] juce::String windowTitle() const { return pluginRunner ? "DrumTrainer - " + juce::String::fromUTF8(pluginRunner->displayName().c_str()) : juce::String("DrumTrainer"); }
void restoreDrumMap() { if (const auto file = DrumMapStore::savedFile()) { loadDrumMapFile(*file); } }
[[nodiscard]] bool hasDrumMapFile() const { return m_drumMapPath != juce::File{}; }
[[nodiscard]] juce::String drumMapName() const { return pluginRunner ? juce::String::fromUTF8(pluginRunner->drumMapName().c_str()) : juce::String{}; }
[[nodiscard]] const DrumDisplay::DisplayPattern& getDisplayPattern() { static const DrumDisplay::DisplayPattern empty{}; return pluginRunner ? pluginRunner->displayPattern() : empty; }
[[nodiscard]] bool presetHasSwing(int idx) const noexcept { return pluginRunner && pluginRunner->isPresetSwing(idx); }
